description: This file contains unit tests for custom option formatters and formatter resolution in an Orleans-based application, using Xunit for testing. It defines test classes, formatter classes, and a mock logger factory to verify formatter behavior, including redaction and named options.

classes.name: LogFomatterTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying custom option formatter and formatter resolution functionalities, including redaction, named options, and formatter overrides.

classes.name: TestOptions
classes.description: Simple options class with an integer field used in tests.

classes.name: TestOptionsWithSecrets
classes.description: Options class with sensitive data fields, demonstrating redaction in formatter output.

classes.name: TestOptionsWithListAndDictionary
classes.description: Options class containing list and dictionary properties, used to test formatting of collections.

classes.name: TestOptionsFormatter
classes.description: Custom formatter for TestOptions, implementing IOptionFormatter, with support for named instances via nested Resolver class.

classes.name: TestOptionsFormatter2
classes.description: Alternate formatter for TestOptions, demonstrating different formatting style and named resolution.

classes.name: TestLoggerFactory
classes.description: Mock implementation of ILoggerFactory for capturing log entries during tests.

classes.name: TestLogger
classes.description: Generic logger wrapper that delegates to an underlying ILogger<T>.

classes.name: TestOptionsLogger
classes.description: Derived class from OptionsLogger used in tests to verify logging behavior.

methods.name: CanResolveFormatter
methods.description: Test verifying that a specific formatter can be resolved and produces expected output.

methods.name: CanResolveGenericFormatter
methods.description: Test verifying that a generic formatter can be resolved and produces expected output.

methods.name: GenericFormatterRedact
methods.description: Test verifying that sensitive data is redacted in formatter output.

methods.name: GenericFormatterWithListAndDictionary
methods.description: Test verifying formatting of options containing collections.

methods.name: FormatterConfiguredTwiceDoesNotLeadToDuplicatedFormatter
methods.description: Test ensuring that configuring the same formatter multiple times does not result in duplicates.

methods.name: CustomFormatterOverridesDefaultFormatter_PreRegistration
methods.description: Test verifying that pre-registration formatter configuration overrides defaults.

methods.name: CustomFormatterOverridesDefaultFormatter_PostRegistration
methods.description: Test verifying that post-registration formatter configuration overrides defaults.

methods.name: BuildOptionsExpectedResult
methods.description: Helper method to build expected log output for options.

methods.name: BuildNamedOptionsExpectedResult
methods.description: Helper method to build expected log output for named options.
